ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA open-ended question - terrain adaptability
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: When building transportation lines from Yunnan and Sichuan to Tibet, why does the country insist on building highways before railways? Please answer from the aspect of adaptability to terrain relief.
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: Highway transportation has strong flexibility, and its adaptability to terrain relief is far stronger than that of railways.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a route map of the “Ancient Tea Horse Road.” The routes connect Yunnan, Sichuan, and the Tibet area, and place names such as Kunming, Dali, Kangding, Chengdu, and Lhasa can be seen in the image. The related routes show an obviously winding form. Combining the geographic background that the Yunnan, Sichuan, and Tibet regions where these routes are located have many plateaus and mountains and large terrain relief, it can be inferred that transportation construction from Yunnan and Sichuan to Tibet needs to adapt to complex terrain. The question stem limits the answer to the aspect of “adaptability to terrain relief,” so the adaptability of highways and railways to complex undulating terrain should be compared: highway transportation has strong flexibility, and highway alignments can relatively flexibly climb slopes, turn, and avoid complex terrain; railways are more greatly restricted by gradient and turning radius, and their adaptability to areas with large terrain relief is relatively weak. Therefore, the country insists on building highways before railways because highways are far more adaptable to terrain relief than railways.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 桥接规则：马帮古道和弯曲山地通道反映沿线地形复杂、通行需要灵活性；现代交通中，公路在选线、坡度、急弯和分段施工方面比铁路更灵活，铁路对平缓纵坡和较大曲线半径要求高。

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：图中为“茶马古道”线路图，粗实线表示茶马古道线路，连接云南、四川和西藏等地；线路在昆明、大理、丽江、康定、成都以及巴塘、昌都、林芝、拉萨等地之间呈现明显弯曲、绕行的形态，不是笔直通达。推理：材料说明茶马古道以马帮（骡马）运输为基础，这说明滇川藏通道长期需要依靠灵活的运输方式来适应山高谷深、地势起伏大的环境。现代交通建设中，公路选线和运行都更灵活，可以通过盘山、绕行等方式适应起伏地形；铁路对坡度、曲线半径等要求更严格，适应地势起伏的能力较弱。所以从地势起伏适应性看，应先建公路后建铁路。
solver_metadata.model_answer: 因为公路运输灵活性强，线路可弯曲绕行，对山高谷深、地势起伏大的地形适应性远强于铁路；铁路对坡度和曲线限制严格，所以坚持先公路后铁路。

verify_reports.critic_suggestions: 该推理链基本合格。它先描述图像中茶马古道线路跨云南、四川、西藏且线路弯曲绕行的视觉特征，再结合题干中“以马帮（骡马）运输为基础”的文字信息推理，最后从地势起伏适应性角度回答公路比铁路更灵活、对起伏地形适应性更强。最终结论与标准答案一致。可进一步精简最终作答，突出“公路运输灵活性强，对地势起伏适应性强；铁路受坡度和曲线限制大”。

problem_metadata.open_variant_title: GeoSQA 开放题-地形适应性

raw_record.original_question: 在建设云南、四川通往西藏的交通线时，国家为什么坚持先公路后铁路？请从对地势起伏的适应性方面回答。
raw_record.answer: Highway transportation has strong flexibility, and its adaptability to terrain relief is far stronger than that of railways.
raw_record.final_cot: The image shows a route map of the “Ancient Tea Horse Road.” The routes connect Yunnan, Sichuan, and the Tibet area, and place names such as Kunming, Dali, Kangding, Chengdu, and Lhasa can be seen in the image. The related routes show an obviously winding form. Combining the geographic background that the Yunnan, Sichuan, and Tibet regions where these routes are located have many plateaus and mountains and large terrain relief, it can be inferred that transportation construction from Yunnan and Sichuan to Tibet needs to adapt to complex terrain. The question stem limits the answer to the aspect of “adaptability to terrain relief,” so the adaptability of highways and railways to complex undulating terrain should be compared: highway transportation has strong flexibility, and highway alignments can relatively flexibly climb slopes, turn, and avoid complex terrain; railways are more greatly restricted by gradient and turning radius, and their adaptability to areas with large terrain relief is relatively weak. Therefore, the country insists on building highways before railways because highways are far more adaptable to terrain relief than railways.

critic_agent_reviews.critic_suggestions: 总体推理方向与标准答案一致，也基本遵循了“先描述图像，再推理”的顺序。但需修订少量图像依据表述：图中可见昆明、大理、康定、成都、拉萨等地和曲折线路，但“丽江”并不清晰/未在图中标注，不应说“可见丽江”；“青藏高原及横断山地”更多是由线路所在区域结合地理常识推断，不能表述成图中直接显示。建议改为：图中茶马古道线路连接云南、四川和西藏，经过昆明、大理、康定、成都、拉萨等附近，线路曲折；结合这些地区位于高原山地、地势起伏大，可推断交通建设需适应复杂地形。最后保留公路灵活、铁路受坡度和转弯半径限制大的比较。
major_failures: 存在一个不够可靠的图像细节 claim：候选链称图中可见“丽江”，但所附图中该地名未清晰标注/不可确认。
“穿行在青藏高原及横断山地”不是图像直接标注的信息，应说明为根据云南、四川、西藏的位置和地理常识推断，而非直接从图像读取。

critic_agent_reviews.critic_suggestions: 推理 trace 基本通过。其先描述图像中的茶马古道线路、涉及云南/四川/西藏及线路曲折形态，再结合题干限定比较公路与铁路对地势起伏的适应性，最终答案与标准答案一致。唯一需注意的是，图像本身主要是线路示意图，并未直接呈现地形起伏；“滇、川、藏地区多高原山地、地势起伏大”属于区域地理背景知识与线路曲折形态的结合判断，应避免表述成完全由图像直接显示。
该推理链基本合格。它先描述图像中茶马古道线路跨云南、四川、西藏且线路弯曲绕行的视觉特征，再结合题干中“以马帮（骡马）运输为基础”的文字信息推理，最后从地势起伏适应性角度回答公路比铁路更灵活、对起伏地形适应性更强。最终结论与标准答案一致。可进一步精简最终作答，突出“公路运输灵活性强，对地势起伏适应性强；铁路受坡度和曲线限制大”。
